content: Name Crypto_ Verify Result Type Kind Enumeration Range CRYPTO_ E_ VER_ OK 0x00 The result of the verification is "true", i.e. the two compared elements are identical. This return code shall be given as value "0" CRYPTO_ E_ VER_ NOT_ OK 0x01 The result of the verification is "false", i.e. the two compared elements are not identical. This return code shall be given as value "1". Description Enumeration of the result type of verification operations. Variation -- Available via Rte_ Csm_ Type.h
